meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能检查或配置 claude-mem 与 cmem.ai Pro 的云同步：读取同步状态、写入连接令牌、重启并验证；不打印令牌，只报告设备 ID、待处理数量等。
howto.when: 当用户说“设置云同步”、“同步我的记忆”、“cmem pro”等，或想把记忆数据库备份/同步到 cmem.ai 账户时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置 claude-mem 云同步
say.note: Claude会要求你提供 cmem.ai 连接的三项信息。
Claude会查询并报告设备ID和同步状态。

say.text: 我的记忆同步到 cmem.ai 了吗？
say.note: Claude会检查配置并验证 SyncHub 连接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can check or set up cloud sync between claude-mem and cmem.ai Pro: read sync status, write connection values, restart and verify; never prints the token, only reports device ID, pending counts, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", etc., or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

say_en.text: Help me set up claude-mem cloud sync
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the three connection values from cmem.ai.
Claude will query and report device ID and sync status.

say_en.text: Are my memories synced to cmem.ai?
say_en.note: Claude will check settings and verify the SyncHub connection.
